name: مقهي ترافيك Traffic Cafe
address: Hamsa Building - Khalid Bin Al Waleed Rd - Al Karama - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
owner_description:
Traffic Cafe is the perfect spot for coffee lovers and anyone looking to enjoy a relaxed, friendly atmosphere in the heart of Al Karama, Dubai. We offer a wide selection of freshly brewed coffee and drinks in a cozy setting, ideal for catching up with friends or enjoying some quiet time.

📍 Location: Al Karama – Ansar Gallery Building, Dubai
📞 Contact: +971 50 300 3604

reviews.author: Boris Hada
reviews.text:
Had a wonderful experience at Traffic Cafe! The ambience was beautiful, relaxing, and perfect for spending quality time. The food was delicious and well-prepared, making the visit even more enjoyable.

A special thanks to Miss Sagun for her outstanding hospitality. She was incredibly humble, kind, and attentive throughout our visit, making us feel truly welcome. Her warm service really made our experience memorable.

Highly recommended, and I'll definitely be visiting again! 🌟
reviews.owner_reply: Thank you and we wish you a pleasant visit.

reviews.author: A Zami
reviews.text:
I had an amazing experience at this hookah lounge and restaurant. The atmosphere was great, the hookah was smooth and flavorful, and the food was honestly delicious — everything we ordered was fresh and full of flavor.

A special shoutout to Beza for the outstanding service. She was incredibly friendly, attentive, and made us feel welcome from the moment we arrived. Her positive attitude and attention to detail really made the whole experience even better.

I loved everything about this place and will definitely be coming back. Highly recommend for anyone looking for great food, relaxing vibes, and excellent customer service!

reviews.author: ahmed alharbi
reviews.text: I would like to compliment Sogun for her excellent service. She was very friendly, professional, and attentive throughout our visit. She made sure we had everything we needed and made our experience very pleasant. Thank you, Sogun, for the great service!

reviews.author: Rashmi Rapz
reviews.text: I think we need to do 10 star rating for this...I just have 5 stars to click here... Marabella tweek the best ever flavour of Hookah that I have had till now ....that rustic......oh man ♂️ just in Love 😘 Superb care @ Dubai

reviews.author: ATLIS IMMIGRATION
reviews.text: Complete amazing experience. Being a vegetarian, finding delicious meals is always a challenge. But here right from appetizers to main course to dessert - everything was so mouthwatering. We were a party of 6- from adults to kids and  from liking typical Indian to western cuisines. All of us had a wonderful experience dining experience. My son said that he liked all the dishes so much! Highly recommended! It is a must try

reviews.author: Shweta bhagvatula
reviews.text:
This place is at the junction and the ambience is good. Staff is good but the service is bit slow. Shisha is good but again you will have to call the staff many times to get one thing done. Coffee was good in taste. Service needs to be improved.

When we visited this place it was not even crowded, so if the service was not good when it the place is not crowded then I am not sure how it will be when the place is crowded. If you are looking for a place to have a quick bite or shisha then you can definitely visit this place.
reviews.owner_reply: We apologize to you, Madam, for the service, but we promise that the service will be fine next time

reviews.author: Ahmed Abbas
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful cafes and restaurants in Dubai with an amazing ambiance and stylish setting. The food is delicious, fresh, and well served , the service is excellent with very friendly and responsive staff. Overall, a great spot for a relaxing and high-quality dining experience.
